notes.title: v1.0.4 is live!
notes.notes:
Hey,

We just pushed a build with several patches that some of you were waiting for. Here's the list:

- There was a problem with the [b]Steam Achievements[/b] on Windows and MacOS. This is now resolved! Just connect to the game and you'll receive the achievements you previously missed.
- [b]Steam Overlay[/b] is now available with SHIFT+TAB. Warning, we cannot guarantee that it'll work on every system.
- The game in default difficulty level (level 3) is now [b]slightly easier[/b] (or less difficult :))
- Some adjustments were made on the tutorial and the Cardanian campaign.
- We can now change the difficulty level and the keyboard shortcuts from the campaign menu.
- We can now tune the music and sound effects from the tactical view in a mission.
- Some translation errors have been corrected.

If you find other bugs or have ideas for improvements, let us know!
Enjoy!

notes.title: The game is out!
notes.notes:
We're really proud and happy to finally release our brand new game "Asylamba : Influence" here on Steam.

You can get the game for a pretty fair price. Additionnaly there is a [b]10% launch discount[/b] during the first week. So don't hesitate!

We have also thought about people who want more. Indeed, [b]two bundles[/b] are available with either the wallpapers of the game in high quality, or the complete soundtrack. These bundles are for fans and people who want to support our video game studio.

We hope that your gaming experience will be a great one. We answer all questions and comments in the community tab.

Your [b]reviews are important[/b] to guide future game updates, so let's go!

Enjoy!
The RTFM Corp. team

notes.title: Hello World
notes.notes:
We're proud to annouce the launch date of our brand new game called Asylamba: Influence! It will be [b]May 23rd at 10am PDT (19pm CEST)[/b], right here on Steam.

The page on the Steam store is up and running since few days now. If you like what you see on this page, you can already add the game to your [b]wishlist[/b]. And if you have any questions about the game, don't hesitate to ask on the Community page or on our forum at [url=https://asylamba.com]https://asylamba.com[/url]. We'll be happy to answer you and to know what you think.

Have a nice weekend,
RTFM Corp. team :)
